Use case: ui-mockup. Design a presentation sheet containing exactly TWO distinct compact Korean Spinatlas app modal redesigns, top and bottom, each with a small numbered Korean caption outside its modal. This is a set of EXISTING product screens restyled, not new features. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: inherit its beautiful white opaque surface, cobalt #2457d6 controls, pale #eef3fc blue side region where specified, dark navy bold condensed tabular numeric typography, fine slate body type, restrained thin separators, round pale close-X, crisp athletic instrument feel, modest rounded corners and soft shadow. Do NOT reproduce the speed screen. Flat straight-on web UI, no devices, no photographs, no perspective, no poster decoration, no gradients, no neon, no invented widgets/metrics/navigation. Light neutral slate page background, generous spacing BETWEEN panels, dense purposeful spacing INSIDE each compact panel. Both panels fully visible and large legible Korean text. Preserve stated proportions; present high resolution scaled versions of the stated CSS pixel dimensions so text stays clear. UI language Korean. A primary metric is bold and large only where it is actually meaningful; do not add meaningless gauges to settings or lists. A real implementable app design, not a marketing landing page.
TOP caption "01  인터벌 운동". Modal about 360x210 CSS pixels, broad compact rectangle. Header "인터벌 운동", blue pill toggle "사용", preset dropdown "20분", circular X. Main focal number "20:00" with quiet label "총 운동 시간". Under it slim segmented horizontal workout timeline with subtle blue intensities for phases, exact short labels "준비 · 고강도 · 저강도 · 마무리". Small phase detail "준비 2분 · 30초 / 30초 × 16 · 마무리 2분" (sums to20 minutes). Text button "직접 조절", no open input grid, bottom footer aligned actions outlined "간편 인터벌" LEFT of cobalt "설정 적용". Show no start/play button here.
BOTTOM caption "02  케이던스 센서". Modal420x211 proportions with 30% pale left status section. Left "케이던스", giant "82" and small "rpm", tiny green dot and "연결됨", tiny "Wahoo CADENCE". Right header "케이던스 센서" and round X. Center small cobalt pedal/cadence icon and compact large inline numeric "28.7 km/h", label "가상 속도". Helpful line "페달을 돌리면 속도가 바뀌어요." Footer two buttons outlined "연결 해제", solid "이 센서로 달리기", secondary quiet "센서 없음". No speed slider or manual +- in this connected-cadence mode. Reference's blue segmented motif may sit tastefully beside actual rpm, not a second giant speed gauge.
